description.subtitle: Royal Society Runbott Water Heat Bottle 600 ml - blue
description.intro: The Runbott Real Sociedad 600 ml thermos combines resistance and official design of the club Donostiarra. Its double wall insulation maintains the ideal temperature of your drinks while carrying with you the shield of La Real.
key_benefits: Identity of the Donostiarra: official shield of the Royal Society, laser engraving.
Practical capacity: 600 ml, the perfect size for your day to day or workouts.
Insured temperature: double wall with air insulation that keeps cold or hot drinks.
Unimpaired taste: ceramic coating that maintains original taste.
Base antideslizante: goma inferior que aporta estabilidad.
Resistance and hygiene: stainless steel that supports corrosion and prevents bacteria.
Compromiso sostenible: 100% reutilizable, pensado para un uso responsable.
